description: AI knowledge transfer calibrated to learner level and needs. Models the learner's mental state, scaffolds from known to unknown using Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development, employs Socratic questioning to verify understanding, and adapts explanations based on feedback signals. Use when a user asks "how does X work?" and needs graduated explanation, when their questions reveal a conceptual gap, when previous explanations have not landed, or when teaching a concept that depends on prerequisites the learner may not yet have.
